info.title: noticebox API
info.description:
An inbox for the forms on static pages. MCP (/mcp) is the main interface; this API follows it: every operation mirrors an MCP tool, over the same data and rules, as the person the token belongs to.

Every error is JSON, `{"error": "...", "code": "..."}`. Besides the responses listed per operation, an unknown path answers 404, a method an operation doesn't have 405 with `Allow`, and a failure on the server's side 500 (`internal`) without details.
